claim_en: THE COVENANT'S CARGO ITEMIZED: 'all the WORDS of the LORD and all the JUDGMENTS' — the narrative and THIS PARASHAH'S ORDINANCES named as two payloads in the intake line; the people answer with one voice. Spine silent over the chapter; Onkelos is the declared reading, recorded.

check.note: The parashah's own ordinances named inside the covenant scene.

claim_en: THE FIRSTBORN OFFICIATE: 'the youths of the children of Israel' rendered THE FIRSTBORN — the pre-Levitical priesthood decided in translation; the offerings 'holy slaughterings.'

check.note: An office assigned by the received translation.

claim_en: THE COVENANT IS A DOCUMENT READ ALOUD AND ACCEPTED: the book read before the people; na'aseh ve-nishma rendered 'we will DO and we will RECEIVE' — the Targum's obedience idiom carrying hearing-as-receiving.

check.note: The acceptance formula in the translation's receiving idiom.

claim_en: THE COVENANT BLOOD AS ATONEMENT: the altar half-blood thrown 'TO ATONE FOR THE PEOPLE'; the covenant CUT (gzar) 'upon all these words' — sealed over the parashah's ordinances.

check.note: The kapparah function written into the verse by the translation.

claim_en: THE VISION DOUBLE-BUFFERED, THE MEAL TRANSPOSED: saw-God → saw the GLORY; under-His-feet → under the THRONE of His glory; laid-not-His-hand → NO INJURY; ate-and-drank → 'rejoiced in their offerings which were accepted with favor, AS IF eating and drinking' — the simile-word inserted into the received text.

check.note: Four buffers across two verses, one consistent machine.

claim_en: THE STANDING COURT OF THE FORTY DAYS: 'whoever has words' rendered 'whoever HAS A CASE shall approach' Aaron and Hur — the bench that keeps the new ordinances running during the ascent; the tablets grant itemized 'the Torah and the commandment which I have written TO TEACH THEM.'

check.note: The judiciary continuity clause rendered as law; the teaching purpose explicit.

claim_en: THE UNNAMED-ELDERS DOCTRINE (F-019): the seventy elders left nameless so that every three that stands as a court over Israel is AS THE COURT OF MOSES — institutional continuity derived from this unit's silence; the rule that decides the calendar-submission case.

check.note: A standing-authority rule derived from an absence in this unit's ink.

claim_en: THE SEQUESTERING PRINCIPLE AND THE CANON CHANNEL. The cloud's six days read as a BUILDING PRINCIPLE — whoever enters the camp of the Presence requires six days' sequestering (the High Priest's week from Moses' six; the mishnah's seventh a recorded precaution; ascended-covered-SANCTIFIED in the cloud). The date-dispute mapping (after-the-utterances vs from-the-New-Moon = the sixth-vs-seventh split, the forty days closing on the seventeenth of Tammuz for the breaking). The covering's three recorded purposes; the call with all Israel standing; the entry contradiction (could-not-enter vs came-into) resolved both ways — grasped-and-brought, or the path through the cloud as through the sea. Call-before-speech: the manners and confidentiality rules. And THE CANON CHANNEL: tablets/Torah/commandment/which-I-have-written/to-teach-them = the utterances, Scripture, MISHNAH, the Prophets and Writings, TALMUD — the whole library from the one giving verse, the two-channel charter's second seat beside 34:27. Filed F-083, auto-seated (round 23, the covenant block).
